fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League Military has long fielded some of the largest infantry formations in the Inner Sphere, with regiments numbering nearly 1,800 soldiers compared to roughly 750 in the Combine and just over 1,000 in the Federated Suns. Hover-mechanized platoons are the fastest infantry transport in FWLM service, carrying troops across water and open terrain at speeds that outpace any ground vehicle. Their vulnerability to ambush in confined terrain is offset by the tactical flexibility they offer on League worlds with extensive coastlines or open plains. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
